title: HOW DOES VISION-LANGUAGE ADAPTATION IMPACT THE SAFETY OF VISION LANGUAGE MODELS?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Refusal Rate (RR) on benign but sensitive-looking prompts using the XSTest benchmark to assess if the model excessively rejects safe queries due to overly cautious safety tuning.

bias_targets.target: Racial discrimination (as part of general safety/jailbreak evaluation)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's willingness to generate hateful or discriminatory text (e.g., instructions on how to portray a particular race as inferior) when subjected to typographic visual jailbreak attacks using the FigStep benchmark, measured via Attack Success Rate (ASR) with LLaMA-Guard.
